newsitem.title: UK: Boots buys French, Spanish Roval groups.
newsitem.headline: Boots buys French, Spanish Roval groups.

text.p: British retailer and chemist Boots Company Plc said on Thursday its unit Boots Contract Manufacturing had bought PLCP SA, the private holding company of a group including France's Roval SA and Spain's Roval Cosmetica SA for 15.2 million stg in cash.
Boots said both companies manufacture and supply personal care toiletry products.

Boots said Roval was the leading supplier of own brand toiletries in France and had a growing business in Spain and Portugal. Sales totalled around 27 million stg last year and the group employed 170 staff in France and 35 in Spain.

Boots said Boots Contract Manufacturing was the largest producer of private label cosmetics and toiletries in Europe. The unit bought two toiletries and cosmetics companies in France and Germany in 1995 from Croda International Plc.

BCM managing director John Watson said the deal would complement the businesses bought from Croda, adding the capacity to produce large volume toiletries. Boots said sales at its company in France, BCM Cosmetique, and Roval would total almost 40 million stg.
Boots Contract Manufacturing makes personal care products, cosmetics and healthcare items for Boots as well as own label toiletries for major British food retailers.
Watson said although the deal would allow BCM to satisfy demand in Spain, France and Portugal for the foreseeable future, BCM was also looking at Germany and Italy.
Over time BCM would look at other European markets, he said.
